project_naming.policy: LBW and YBW are names/identifiers, not combustion-mode labels. Never infer a physical mode meaning from the repository name.

teacher_direction.primary_instruction: Build the one-dimensional ramjet/scramjet model first, using the teacher-provided CFD formulas and Cao Ruifeng references; the teacher described this as a second, more accurate scheme that may be advanced as effort permits.
teacher_direction.target_model_family: unsteady quasi-one-dimensional conservative CFD model for a dual-mode/scramjet combustor
primary_reference_set: Teacher-provided photographed Chapter 11: 双模态冲压燃烧室一维数值模拟
曹瑞峰：面向控制的超燃冲压发动机一维建模研究
曹瑞峰：超燃冲压发动机燃烧模态转换及其控制方法研究

unsteady_quasi_1d_conservative_pde.evidence: Production solver advances conservative quasi-1D mass/momentum/energy states with variable area.

cfl_time_step.note: Teacher reference shows a specific one-half acoustic/convective cap; project currently exposes a general CFL-controlled implementation rather than hard-coding one constant.

teacher_reference_inlet_outlet_compatibi.note: Supersonic primitive inflow and transmissive/outflow semantics can reproduce the cited inlet static p/T/u and first-order extrapolation once rho is derived consistently.

near_sonic_eigenvalue_smoothing.note: Current Steger-Warming uses raw lambda +/- |lambda| splitting. The reference uses a smoothed eigenvalue near lambda=0. No epsilon is guessed until the source or project policy freezes it.

teacher_relative_density_convergence_met.note: Current steady solver uses a normalized semi-discrete residual. The reference additionally uses max relative density change between iterations. Both can coexist.

temperature_and_composition_dependent_th.reference: Teacher Chapter 11 Eqs. 11.30-11.35 and Cao references
temperature_and_composition_dependent_th.note: Production gas model is calorically perfect with constant gamma/R. A study utility already evaluates NASA7 cp polynomials for one fixed-composition reduction, but variable thermo is not solver-integrated.

mixing_efficiency_and_mixing_length_clos.note: Current solver accepts prescribed injection/burning profiles but does not yet compute the teacher-reference empirical mixing efficiency and mixing length.

equivalence_ratio_and_fuel_specific_comp.note: Current production solver does not evolve/close species composition from equivalence ratio and combustion efficiency.

teacher_empirical_friction_closure.note: Generic prescribed Darcy friction is implemented, but the teacher-reference empirical f(phi*eta) closure is not.

teacher_empirical_wall_heat_closure.note: Generic prescribed wall heat flux is implemented, but the teacher-reference q(phi*eta) closure is not.

chemical_energy_bookkeeping_consistency.reference: Teacher Chapter 11 energy equation and composition-dependent enthalpy treatment
chemical_energy_bookkeeping_consistency.note: The reference distinguishes external wall/additional heat from chemical reaction energy. The existing direct Qdot combustion path is a validated surrogate interface, not the final teacher-reference chemistry formulation. Future variable-composition implementation must avoid double-counting chemical energy through both Qdot and species enthalpy.

source_backed_validation_and_vv.note: P10/P11.2 NASA and literature benchmark work remains valuable for verification and evidence discipline, but it must not displace implementation of the teacher-provided model.

overall_assessment.primary_correction_needed: Recenter the roadmap from an invented LBW/YBW mode-classification milestone onto completion of the teacher-reference second-scheme physics/numerics.
next_priority: Add the teacher Eq. 11.46 relative-density convergence diagnostic without replacing the existing residual gate.
Freeze the teacher-reference thermochemical data/coefficients and implement variable T/composition thermodynamics in an isolated, tested layer.
Implement source-backed mixing efficiency/mixing-length and equivalence-ratio/composition closures.
Implement teacher-reference friction and wall-heat empirical closures as optional models, preserving generic prescribed-source interfaces.
Add near-sonic Steger-Warming eigenvalue smoothing only after its epsilon policy is explicitly sourced/frozen.
Build a teacher-reference integrated case before returning to combustion-mode transition studies.
